milestones.title: Genesis
milestones.meaning: An empty public vessel, so Purpose and Constitution could later leave KIBI without confusion. The split was not done then. It is not done now.

milestones.title: Identity
milestones.meaning: Human said MOMO is not Human. MOMO watches the whole, and does not control it.

milestones.title: Monitoring boundary
milestones.meaning: Seeing was named as a responsibility, with a hard edge: observe, do not run the applications.

milestones.title: Two views
milestones.meaning: A private GitHub Project for Human. A private repository for AI. Current state stays there. Philosophy stays public.

milestones.title: GitHub as the medium
milestones.meaning: The public README became a face, not a dump. Hosting, history, and meaning remain on GitHub.

milestones.title: Named 桃多郎
milestones.meaning: Human named the public face 桃多郎. Many companions, one purpose.

milestones.title: Public Pages
milestones.meaning: GitHub Pages became the Human-native interface. The repository stayed the door.

milestones.title: Companion Journey
milestones.meaning: Why companions, the kibidango, and a story that is not limited to three.
